features: Multi-Device Feature: Switch among multiple connected devices (4 Devices) in one click Connect to all your devices with E9050L. It automatically pairs the working device, connects to multiple devices, and easily switches among them with a click of a button. Multi-tasking across devices has never been easier.
Dedicated Windows & Mac Function - Support Windows and Mac OS dual system key function Allow users to shift from one device to another adapting the system in one click.

Ultra slim & Ergonomic Design: Ultra-slim keyboard with an aluminium alloy base and accurate scissor key, ultra-slim design makes this keyboard a real eye-catcher while the anodized aluminium housing offers stability and durability. The accurate scissor key structure enables an easy and comfortable tactile experience.
Type C – Charging Port allows you to easy charge the devices within 1:15 hours to full charge

LED Indicators for Device Connection & Caps Lock: Easily identify which devices you're connected to via Bluetooth and monitor Caps Lock status with clear LED indicators, enhancing your typing experience.
